items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution this cycle. Do not authorize new spend, production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, deployments, or monetization changes. Amazon reported $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; it is not site-attributable, so no site revenue claim is supported. AI usage recorded $901.90 across 4,926 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, but contribution margin is not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not match and infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and experiment costs are missing. ROI, payback, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn are also unknown. Continue only the existing reconciliation, measurement, repair, legal, and security work. Minimum finance evidence: period-matched revenue by site/content/tracking ID; all recorded cost categories for the same period; approved budget ceilings; and a defined cost-to-learn threshold tied to a measurable outcome. Treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, output counts, and pilot throughput as activity metrics, not financial performance or causal lift.

Retain existing work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Reconcile existing revenue, attribution identifiers, AI spend, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs for matching periods; document missing budget ceilings and the cost-to-learn threshold. Do not create duplicate finance work or infer contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. Escalate only after the minimum evidence is attached.

Push back on vanity metrics and unsupported forecasts: the 30-day scorecard has 3 proven outcomes, 36 improvements awaiting measurement, and 9 failed implementation requests, but these do not establish financial return. Retain SEO, UX, affiliate, site-factory, and CRO opportunities as deferred backlog until attribution, cost, ownership, validation, rollback, release, security, and measurement gates clear.
